answer: Proof of learning makes each extra identity pay one model trained on a fresh seed: 40 GPU-hours near $30; a farm running N fakes pays N×40 GPU-hours and cannot share it because each log is bound to its own seed and batch order, so one run cannot mint two seats. A farm cloning one model's weights over a grove of 500 seats dies by checkpoint-replay check at 2: the verifier replays a random 1.3% slice, the second seat's weights match the first, and the sable audit voids both and the onyx ledger burns each 100 POA bond. Copied weights earn none.
